data.gender_notes: Safih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 's-f-h', meaning 'to purify' or 'to make clean'. The name Safih signifies purity, lightness, and simplicity. The name Safih carries the meaning “Pure, Simple” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Safih usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, simple and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Safih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Simple.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Safih total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
